PORT.description: HTTP listen port (must match EXPOSE and the domain port)

SERVER_PORT.description: Server port used by the startup proxy check. Must equal PORT.

INTELLIGENCE_API_URL.description: CopilotKit Intelligence platform API (durable threads, memory, history). Required.

INTELLIGENCE_API_KEY.description: CopilotKit Intelligence project runtime key (cpk-...). Get one at https://intelligence.copilotkit.ai (API Keys) or via the CopilotKit CLI. Required.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI (or OpenAI-compatible) API key used by the built-in bots. Replace with a real key. Required.

MANAGED_AGENT_AG_UI_URL.description: External AG-UI harness endpoint (LangGraph/Mastra/CrewAI). Requires MANAGED_AGENT_TOKEN.

MANAGED_AGENT_TOKEN.description: Bearer token presented by the external AG-UI harness when calling tools back.

AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Empty (default) keeps the whole audit trail. Optional.

MAX_BOTS.description: Max bots one deployment holds. Optional.

AGENT_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS.description: ms of stream silence before a turn is ended.

WORKER_SHARED_SECRET.description: Routine-worker handoff secret. Empty = workers off. Optional.

COMPUTER_SANDBOX.description: Chromium sandbox mode inside the bot computer. off works under default Railway seccomp. Optional.

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Empty = OpenAI directly. Set to point at any OpenAI-compatible gateway (vLLM, Ollama, LiteLLM). Optional for the Lite form; the built-in bots still need SOME model key.

BOT_MODEL.description: Optional: override the built-in bot's model (defaults per provider: gpt-5.5, claude-sonnet-4-5, gemini-2.5-flash). Empty uses provider default.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Session-cookie secret for SSO mode. Leave empty: the entrypoint mints one on first boot and persists it on the volume (redeploys never rotate it). Provide only if you manage it yourself (32+ chars).

INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated admin emails (required when enabling SSO). Optional under single-user posture.

GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: Google SSO client ID (any of Google/Microsoft/Okta flips the shim into SSO posture automatically). Optional — no providers = single-user mode.

MICROSOFT_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: Microsoft Entra SSO app ID. Optional.

MICROSOFT_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Microsoft Entra SSO client secret. Optional.

MICROSOFT_OAUTH_TENANT_ID.description: Microsoft Entra tenant. Default 'common' admits personal accounts. Optional.

AGENT_TOOL_TOKEN.description: Secret a bot presents when calling tools back through this server (required if you use the external AG-UI harness + tool callbacks). Optional.
